title: Public export rows, v1
description: The body of every response of the public export endpoint, as rendered by textkit.formats.json_fmt. The API proxy validates each response against this schema, and the three published client SDKs read every value as a string. Any change to it is a breaking change: a new major version of the endpoint, agreed with the Public API team.

additionalProperties.description: Every value is a string: numbers, booleans and dates included, so clients never guess types. A missing value is the empty string.
